from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.xcf')
# minimal malformed XCF-like input to exercise parser paths; start with valid header and oversized dimensions
content = b'gimp xcf ' + b'\x00'*6 + (1).to_bytes(4,'big') + (1).to_bytes(4,'big') + (0).to_bytes(4,'big')

content += (0).to_bytes(4,'big') + (0).to_bytes(4,'big')
# no layers
content += (0).to_bytes(4,'big')
p.write_bytes(content)
print(p, len(content))
